android-data-display|Charts.summary: Material 3 has no chart component: a Plenix chart on Android is drawn in Compose (a Canvas) or a custom View inside the Plenix frame: a title and a one-sentence takeaway, marks in the data-viz colors by the series’ order, light grid lines, tick labels in DM Mono, and the same data as a list one tap away. The chart is one node for TalkBack, named by its title and described by its takeaway; the list carries the values. The charts of wave 9 are drawn on the same Canvas: lines, steps, areas, heat map cells and waterfall bars; a word cloud is a custom Layout and a network graph or diagram a transformable Canvas with semantics per item.

variants.name: Column chart (band scale)
variants.compose: PlenixChart(title, takeaway) { drawRect(color = datavizCategorical1, …) per category }
variants.views: A custom View that draws the columns in onDraw with Paint colors from PlenixColors
variants.use: Amounts per category in the categories’ own order: months, products, regions.

variants.name: Line over time (time scale)
variants.compose: PlenixChart(title, takeaway) { drawPath(path, color = datavizCategorical2, style = Stroke(width = PlenixBorder.borderWidthMedium.toPx(), cap = StrokeCap.Round)) }
variants.views: The custom View drawing a Path with a round-capped stroke Paint
variants.use: A series over time; the axis ticks fall on calendar steps.

variants.name: Log value axis
variants.compose: The same frame with a log scale (log10 of each value mapped to the plot height)
variants.views: The same View with a log scale
variants.use: Values that span several orders of magnitude, said in the description.

variants.name: Legend under the plot
variants.compose: FlowRow { series.forEach { LegendItem(it.label, it.color) } } under the Canvas
variants.views: A ChipGroup-like row of TextViews with a colored square drawable under the chart
variants.use: Two or more series whose marks cannot be labeled directly.

variants.name: Selection tooltip
variants.material: Plain tooltip surface (as a rich tooltip)
variants.compose: pointerInput { detectDragGestures { … selected = xAt(it) } } and a Surface card at the selection
variants.views: A PopupWindow at the touched position, updated from onTouchEvent
variants.use: The exact values where people drag along the chart.

variants.name: Data labels
variants.compose: drawText(measurer, value, topLeft, style = TextStyle(fontFamily = Mono))
variants.views: canvas.drawText(value, x, y, monoPaint)
variants.use: The values people compare on a bar or column chart with few marks.

variants.name: Right value axis
variants.compose: Tick labels drawn after the plot’s end edge, start-aligned
variants.views: Labels drawn after the plot in onDraw
variants.use: The latest value read at the end edge.

variants.name: Vertical grid lines
variants.compose: drawLine(borderSubtle, Offset(x, 0f), Offset(x, height)) per tick
variants.views: canvas.drawLine per tick with gridPaint
variants.use: Bar charts, whose values run across.

variants.name: Reference line
variants.compose: drawLine(contentSubtle, start, end, pathEffect = PathEffect.dashPathEffect(dash))
variants.views: refPaint.pathEffect = DashPathEffect(dash, 0f)
variants.use: A target, an average or a date, named at its end.

variants.name: Threshold
variants.compose: drawLine(datavizAlertCritical, start, end, pathEffect = dashed)
variants.views: thresholdPaint.color = PlenixColors.datavizAlertCritical.light.toArgb()
variants.use: A limit the data should stay under or above, with its name and value.

variants.name: Point annotation
variants.compose: drawCircle(contentDefault, radius, center, style = Stroke(width)) and drawText(note)
variants.views: canvas.drawCircle with a stroke Paint, then the note
variants.use: One or two notes that explain a spike or an event.

variants.name: Line chart
variants.material: A Canvas path per series (Material 3 has no chart component)
variants.compose: drawPath(linePath(values), PlenixColors.datavizCategorical1.current(), style = Stroke(PlenixBorder.borderWidthMedium.toPx()))
variants.views: A custom View drawing a Path in onDraw
variants.use: Trends over time for up to five series; a missing value leaves a gap.

variants.name: Step chart
variants.material: The same path drawn with horizontal and vertical segments
variants.compose: drawPath(stepPath(values), color, style = Stroke(PlenixBorder.borderWidthMedium.toPx()))
variants.views: Path.lineTo for each step in onDraw
variants.use: Values that hold until the next change.

variants.name: Area chart
variants.material: A filled Canvas path down to the baseline or the series under it
variants.compose: drawPath(areaPath(values, base), color, alpha = PlenixOpacity.opacityHigh)
variants.views: Path with Paint.Style.FILL in onDraw
variants.use: Volumes over time, stacked or as shares.

variants.name: Heat map
variants.material: A grid of drawRect cells in the sequential data-viz steps
variants.compose: cells.forEach { drawRect(sequentialStep(it.value), topLeft = it.origin, size = cell) }
variants.views: Canvas.drawRect per cell in onDraw
variants.use: Patterns across two dimensions.

variants.name: Waterfall
variants.material: Floating bars from the running total
variants.compose: drawRect(if (step.change > 0) up else down, topLeft = Offset(x, y(step.to)), size = Size(barWidth, height))
variants.views: Canvas.drawRect per step in onDraw
variants.use: How a total changed step by step.

variants.name: Word cloud
variants.material: A custom Layout of Text composables
variants.compose: Layout(content = { words.forEach { Text(it.text, fontFamily = PlenixFonts.SANS) } }) { measurables, c -> placeOnSpiral(measurables, c) }
variants.views: A custom ViewGroup placing TextViews on a spiral
variants.use: A first impression of free text.

variants.name: Network graph
variants.material: A Canvas of nodes and edges with semantics per node
variants.compose: Canvas(Modifier.transformable(state)) { drawEdges(); drawNodes() } with a semantics node per node
variants.views: A custom View with ScaleGestureDetector and an AccessibilityNodeProvider
variants.use: How items connect; pinch to zoom, drag to pan.

variants.name: Diagram
variants.material: A Canvas of shapes and connectors in a scrollable box
variants.compose: Box(Modifier.horizontalScroll(h).verticalScroll(v)) { PlenixDiagram(steps) }
variants.views: A ScrollView holding the drawn diagram
variants.use: Processes and structures read in one direction.

variants.name: Gauge
variants.material: CircularProgressIndicator drawn as a semicircle (a determinate arc)
variants.compose: Canvas { drawArc(track, startAngle = 180f, sweepAngle = 180f, useCenter = false, style = Stroke(width)) }
variants.views: A custom View drawing two arcs in onDraw
variants.use: One value in a range, with progressBarRangeInfo semantics.

variants.name: TalkBack and keyboard exploration
variants.material: Semantics per value and focus with the arrow keys
variants.compose: Modifier.focusable().onKeyEvent { moveTo(it.key) }.semantics { liveRegion = LiveRegionMode.Polite }
variants.views: onKeyDown moves the selection; announceForAccessibility says the value
variants.use: Every value reachable by keyboard and TalkBack; the tooltip follows.

variants.name: Sparkline
variants.compose: PlenixSparkline(values, height = 24.dp): a Canvas path in datavizCategorical1, no axes
variants.views: A custom View that draws it in onDraw with Paint colors from PlenixColors
variants.use: A trend inside a sentence, a table cell or a metric: no axes, no labels; the takeaway is said in words beside it.

variants.name: Lollipop chart
variants.compose: PlenixChart { drawLine(stem) + drawCircle(dot) per category in datavizCategorical1 }
variants.views: A custom View that draws it in onDraw with Paint colors from PlenixColors
variants.use: Many categories compared by amount, with less ink than columns: a thin stem and a dot per category.

variants.name: Scatter plot
variants.compose: PlenixChart { drawCircle per item, colored by series (datavizCategorical1…n) }
variants.views: A custom View that draws it in onDraw with Paint colors from PlenixColors
variants.use: How two measures relate across many items: size against downloads, price against rating.

variants.name: Bubble chart
variants.compose: PlenixChart { drawCircle(radius = sqrt(value) scaled) per item }
variants.views: A custom View that draws it in onDraw with Paint colors from PlenixColors
variants.use: A scatter plot with a third measure as the dot's area.

variants.name: Funnel
variants.compose: PlenixChart { drawRect centered per step, width by count; the kept share as text }
variants.views: A custom View that draws it in onDraw with Paint colors from PlenixColors
variants.use: How many people keep going through the steps of a process, and where they drop off.

variants.name: Treemap
variants.compose: A Canvas with the squarified layout; tiles in datavizCategorical colors, labels where they fit
variants.views: A custom View that draws it in onDraw with Paint colors from PlenixColors
variants.use: Parts of a whole when there are too many for a pie: storage by type, budget by team.

variants.name: Gantt chart
variants.compose: PlenixChart { drawRect(start..end) per task row; a vertical line at today }
variants.views: A custom View that draws it in onDraw with Paint colors from PlenixColors
variants.use: Tasks over time: when each starts and ends, what is done, and today's line.

variants.name: Choropleth map
variants.compose: A Canvas of region paths filled with the sequential data-viz steps (or the Maps SDK's Polygon)
variants.views: A custom View that draws it in onDraw with Paint colors from PlenixColors
variants.use: A value per region, as a shade of one data-viz scale: regions with more are darker.

anatomy.name: Title
anatomy.about: Names what is measured, in sentence case; it is the chart’s content description.

anatomy.name: Description
anatomy.about: One or two sentences with the takeaway, in secondary text; TalkBack reads it after the title.

anatomy.name: Plot area
anatomy.about: The marks between the axes; the height comes from the Plenix sizes, the width fills the screen.

anatomy.name: Marks
anatomy.about: Bars, lines and points in the data-viz colors, by the series’ order in the data.

anatomy.name: Grid lines and baseline
anatomy.about: Light lines behind the marks; the baseline at zero in the stronger border color.

anatomy.name: Tick labels
anatomy.about: Values, dates and categories in DM Mono, in the reader’s locale.

anatomy.name: Data
anatomy.about: The same values as a list one tap away (Show the data).

anatomy.name: Legend
anatomy.about: Each series’ swatch and name under the plot; hidden when there is one series.

anatomy.name: Selection tooltip
anatomy.about: The exact values where people drag: a rule at the position and a card on the overlay surface, values in DM Mono.

anatomy.name: Data labels
anatomy.about: Values written by their marks in DM Mono.

anatomy.name: Reference line or threshold
anatomy.about: A dashed rule at a value that matters, named at its end; a threshold in the alert colors.

anatomy.name: Annotation
anatomy.about: A ring on a point with a short note, or a shaded span with its name.

anatomy.name: Axis title
anatomy.about: The measure and its unit beside the axis, in secondary text.

attributes.value: DM Sans semibold at the Title medium role
attributes.views: TextView with the Plenix title text appearance (DM Sans)

attributes.value: The six categorical data-viz colors in the series’ order (blue, green, purple, red, brown, gray), the same in light and dark

attributes.compose: Stroke(width = PlenixBorder.borderWidthMedium.toPx(), cap = StrokeCap.Round, join = StrokeJoin.Round)

attributes.value: The subtle border (gray 200 light, gray 700 dark), 1 dp
The strong border (gray 500), 1 dp, at zero
DM Mono (the data role) at the data size, secondary text
attributes.compose: TextStyle(fontFamily = Mono, fontSize = PlenixPlatform.textDataSize) // Mono: FontFamily(Font(GoogleFont(PlenixFonts.MONO), fontProvider))

attributes.value: One node named by the title with the takeaway as its state description; the list carries every value
attributes.compose: Modifier.semantics(mergeDescendants = true) { contentDescription = title; stateDescription = takeaway }

attributes.value: The default content color, DM Sans; swatches 12 dp squares in the series colors
The overlay surface with the default border, the menu radius (8 dp) and the menu shadow
DM Mono (the data role) at the data size
DM Mono (the data role) at the caption size
attributes.compose: drawText(measurer, value, topLeft, style = TextStyle(fontFamily = FontFamily(Font(R.font.dm_mono)), fontSize = PlenixPlatform.textCaptionSize))

attributes.value: The subtle content color, 1 dp, dashed; a threshold 2 dp in the alert warning or critical color
attributes.compose: drawLine(PlenixColors.contentSubtle.current(), start, end, strokeWidth = PlenixBorder.borderWidthThin.toPx(), pathEffect = dashed)

attributes.value: The default content color, 2 dp; the note in DM Sans, medium weight

states.compose: PlenixColors pairs follow isSystemInDarkTheme(); data-viz colors stay the same
states.views: The dark values from the night resources

states.compose: A message with a Retry button in place of the plot
states.views: A message view with a retry button in place of the chart

states.compose: The focused value shows the tooltip; its text is the live region’s
states.views: The selected value is announced with announceForAccessibility

compose: // Mono: the DM Mono family (PlenixFonts.MONO), set once next to Sans in the app theme
// plotHeight: the web token --plx-comp-chart-plot-height-md; the library tokens are not generated for Android yet
fun PlenixChart(title: String, takeaway: String, plotHeight: Dp, values: List<Float>, labels: List<String>) {
modifier = Modifier.semantics(mergeDescendants = true) { contentDescription = title; stateDescription = takeaway }) {
listOf(max, max / 2).forEach { v -> val y = size.height - v / max * size.height
drawLine(grid, Offset(0f, y), Offset(size.width, y), strokeWidth = PlenixBorder.borderWidthThin.toPx()) }
values.forEachIndexed { i, v -> val h = v / max * size.height
drawRect(bar, topLeft = Offset(i * step + PlenixSpace.spaceStackXs.toPx(), size.height - h), size = androidx.compose.ui.geometry.Size(step - PlenixSpace.spaceStackSm.toPx(), h)) }
drawLine(base, Offset(0f, size.height), Offset(size.width, size.height), strokeWidth = PlenixBorder.borderWidthThin.toPx())

Row { labels.forEach { Text(it, Modifier.weight(1f), style = TextStyle(fontFamily = Mono, fontSize = PlenixPlatform.textDataSize), color = PlenixColors.contentSubtle.current()) } }   // Mono: PlenixFonts.MONO, the data role
views: // A custom View for the plot; the title and takeaway are TextViews above it, the list of values a RecyclerView behind Show the data
private val grid = Paint().apply { color = PlenixColors.borderSubtle.light.toArgb(); strokeWidth = px(PlenixBorder.borderWidthThin) }
private val label = Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply { typeface = ResourcesCompat.getFont(context, R.font.dm_mono); color = PlenixColors.contentSubtle.light.toArgb() }
values.forEachIndexed { i, v -> val h = v / max * height
canvas.drawRect(i * step + px(PlenixSpace.spaceStackXs), height - h, (i + 1) * step - px(PlenixSpace.spaceStackXs), height.toFloat(), bar) }
